# Configuration Guide

## Database Settings

The database connection string
defines how the application
connects to the data store.

### Connection Pool

Pool size determines concurrent
connections available to
the application thread pool.

### Timeout Settings

Connection timeout defaults
to 30 seconds. This can be
adjusted via configuration.

## Network Configuration

Port binding controls which
network interface the server
listens on for incoming requests.

### SSL/TLS Settings

Secure connections require
a valid certificate chain
and private key file path.

## Logging Options

Log levels control verbosity
of application output messages.
Debug level provides maximum
detail for troubleshooting.
